question: Within 160 kilometers, where can I find a fast food restaurant aligned with the route to Miles McEnery Gallery, New York, NY from Speert Green, Wayne, NJ?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Speert Green%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 160000 ) AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Speert Green%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Miles McEnery Gallery%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 2000 -- 2 km buffer to define "aligned with the route" )::geography );
